source_family_warning: All three papers share an author and are not independent empirical witnesses. Exact algorithms are verified by independently organized finite searches in this repository.

sources.author: Harry Altman
sources.title: Integer Complexity: Algorithms and Computational Results
used_for: integer-complexity definition and exhaustive root recurrence
Selfridge lower bound and powers of three
distinction between tree expressions and reusable addition-chain intermediates

sources.author: Harry Altman
sources.title: Internal Structure of Addition Chains: Well-Ordering
used_for: binary upper bound and doubling lower bound
distinction between small steps and real-valued defect
star chains are a restricted class
sources.not_used_for: Well-ordering of defect values is not treated as a physical wavecrest or RH sign theorem.
